title: Large language model-based biological age prediction in large-scale populations

evidence_spans.quote: Our results showed
more than 10 million participants
biological age prediction
identify proteomic biomarkers associated with accelerated aging

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This original study analyzes biological-age prediction and reports results in population cohorts. It explicitly studies aging, but current molecular analysis is limited to proteomic biomarkers; epigenetic ages are comparator proxies, so no completed multi-omics analysis is established.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: LLM-predicted overall age and age gap
causal_design_reviewer.comparator: telomere length, frailty index, eight epigenetic ages and four machine-learning models predictions
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: all-cause mortality, aging-related phenotypes and health outcomes, and organ-specific diseases
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: C-index for all-cause mortality; hazard ratio for overall age gap and all-cause mortality

evidence_spans.quote: We validated this approach across six population-based cohorts
